methods: Formalize a missing boundary lemma identified by the selected review.

allowed_variations: Narrow to one formal lemma or one theorem-to-certificate binding.
scope_change_triggers: Formalizing already-covered arithmetic and claiming the full multiplication theorem.

actual_scope: Compose PR2378 signed Boolean phase words with all-field record traversal and its selected full-array tensor action, including common grid scaling and guarded inverse, under completed address-primitive premises.
scope_change_reason: The first drawn formal-interface card is narrowed to the explicit released PR2378 handoff. Its separate signed-word and full-array theorems already exist; the new result is their quantified composition, not another finite arithmetic census.
bottleneck_link: Discharges the encoded phase-payload interface of one selected directed monomial, for every record field, while keeping completed Compact/digit address actions and source/model correspondence explicit.
stop_rule: Kernel-check the composition and semantic boundaries; bind retained source and finite execution; report remaining physical premises without a new exponent claim.
evidence: RecordBridge.lean; fresh KERNEL.json with 46 theorem probes and three rejected false proofs; FINITE.json with 33280 phase cases, three complete 4096-record arrays and six controls.
author: Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, implementation, verification and writing; no subagents or independent human review.
